mcts.selection_experiment: An alternative visit-count root selection won 3/8; the selected mean/minimax root selection won 4/8. These are development results, not an unseen strength estimate.

limitations: The fixed opening suite is small and contains four development games.
MCTS standard-opening suite wins remain 4/8; improvements are in the targeted maze and search behavior.
Losing races and necessary detours can still include backwards pawn moves.
